contracts.scope: Stock-only, serial emitting host. C-BATTLE, C-OUTPUTS, I-S, I-THREATENING, I-ATTACKING and C-IDLE.
contracts.rng: C++ makes no engine RNG draws during admission, item search, scoring or trajectory checking. Native attempted and accepted actions may draw.
contracts.vehicle: Local-player or registered active master-controlled bot vehicle, exact smoke extender, first ready charge and positive stock model program. Actor-addressed class-1 action 0x11 rides frame network message 0x31, replays the native extender on peers, and produces host ID 0x44 synchronized spawns. A stock non-WP charge can still have the 2in_wp launcher program.
contracts.infantry: eWeaponShot(positive key, 1, fixed point) selects equipment. 0x0D subtype 2 wire vectors and native release both derive the actual grenade from the current hand. Guard the sampled launch before sending.
contracts.lifetime: Native queue/slot owns eOrder; no retain after transfer. Preserve live player tasks, native AvoidGrenade and active treatment locks.
contracts.spatial: Before factory/dispatch reserve 25 simulation seconds keyed by vehicle or squad, allied 20 m fallback for ungrouped soldiers. An 8-second infantry release lease checks the same reservation ticket, live member, current authority and geometry; accepted release extends the cooldown. Active cloud presence outside this cache is unknown.
contracts.acceptance: Structural verification is not a smoke-test or runtime authorization.

payload_proof.assumption: audited stock definitions and interaction scripts resolved by active VFS
payload_proof.grenades: Exact positive two-token definition key, empty item damage range, audited effect chain, verified again on current right hand.
payload_proof.vehicle: Match the first accepted resident charge and the audited model program which names its literal spawn.

vehicle_replay.delay_templates: [delay+0x28,+0x30), eAction_Spawn literal at +0x50; physical, flash_grenade_launcher, ProcessBone, or one separate ProcessBone
vehicle_replay.wp: 51mm_eng_mortar_wp and all unknown blocks refuse enqueue on the host for marked actions
vehicle_replay.edge_cases: Native debit/deadline precede event cancellation. A rejected WP timer skips its mixed flash/cap-hide block. Loss of a private pure-only veto across checkpoint load may allow pure smoke. Remote effects need runtime acceptance.
